Job Description

Director, Measurement & Analytics

About Flywheel

Flywheel’s suite of digital commerce solutions accelerate growth across all major digital marketplaces for the world’s leading brands. We give clients access to near real-time performance measurement and improve sales, share, and profit. With teams across the Americas, Europe and APAC, we offer a career with real impact, endless growth opportunities and the support you need to be the best you can be.

The Opportunity

We are seeking a director to support and contribute to our Measurement & Analytics (M&A) team. Reporting to the Senior Director of the M&A consulting practice within Flywheel’s Commerce Intelligence team, you will play a key role in providing internal and external teams with campaign tracking solutions, reporting, and insights that transforms data into actionable business strategies. As a hands-on leader, you will collaborate with cross functional teams, manage client engagements for the world’s leading brands, and contribute to the development of innovative solutions and strategic analysis for client stakeholders.

What You Will Do

Lead and contribute to the delivery of client projects and engagements, ensuring high-quality outputs and actionable insights and recommendations that align with client objectives
Plan, develop and implement analytical frameworks, measurement strategies, and reporting solutions within Business Intelligence tools to support clients' business goals
Provide strategy recommendations, statistical modelling and analytics, test and learn frameworks, and convert insights into actions in collaboration with other team members
Collaborate with senior executives and a wide variety of internal and external stakeholders to identify business challenges and strategic opportunities where analytics can provide value spanning from web and merchandising analytics, media performance, customer lifetime value, and pricing and promotion optimization
Participate in responding to clients’ requests for proposal and presenting Commerce Intelligence capabilities
Lead, grow, and develop an analytics team and mentor broader team members providing training, guidance, and fostering a collaborative culture of analytical excellence
Stay informed about industry best practices, trends, and emerging technologies and contribute to the evolution of the team’s analytical approaches and continuous improvement of processes
Assist in executing the strategic vision for the Measurement & Analytics consulting practice, including supporting service offerings, methodologies, thought leadership content, and growth initiatives
Build and maintain strong relationships with client stakeholders, acting as a trusted advisor on commerce and analytics strategies

Who You Are

Strong experience with learning agendas, hypothesis testing, A/B testing, experimental design, and building road maps
5-7 years’ experience with direct-to-consumer/ eCommerce business reporting, insights, and analysis
Strong experience with data manipulation, visualizations and dashboarding with tools such as Google Data Studio, Tableau, PowerBI, and/ or DOMO reporting suites
Solid understanding of digital advertising, ad servers, and creative tagging; Experience with rich media technologies, real-time bidding, ad exchanges, and 3rd party ad servers such as Google DCM, Atlas, Mediaplex, Mediamind, etc.
Working knowledge of Google Analytics, Adobe Omniture, Crazy Egg, Moz, or other digital/site analytics[EH1.1]
Agency or client-side experience
A self-starter who moves quickly and independently on initiatives without extensive guidance and supervision
Proactively looks ahead and anticipates business needs and makes necessary pivots. Comfortable with change and evolving circumstances.
Strong communication and presentation skills as well as able to develop strong relationships with clients and internal stakeholders and manage expectations.
Creative problem-solving skills and strong attention to detail
Proven project management skills and quality assurance discipline

Working at Flywheel

We are proud to offer all Flywheelers a competitive rewards package and unparalleled career growth opportunities and a supportive, fun and engaging culture.

The Interview Process

Every role starts the same, an introductory call with someone from our Talent Acquisition team. We will be looking for company and values-fit as well as your professional experience; there may be some technical role-specific questions during this call.

Every role is different after the initial call, but you can expect to meet several people from the team 1:1 and there might be further skill assessments in the form of a Take Home Assignment/Case Study Presentation or Pair Programming/Live Coding exercise depending on the role. In your initial call, we will walk you through exactly what to expect the process to be.

jobs.title: Lead Data Scientist / VP
jobs.description:
The Lead Data Scientist will work hands-on across the AI and analytics development lifecycle. The role will design analytical approaches, develop and validate models, build Generative AI and agentic workflows, and partner with data engineers and technology teams to implement scalable production solutions.

The successful candidate will combine strong data-science expertise with practical engineering skills, enterprise implementation experience, and an understanding of governance requirements. The role will also provide technical guidance to other data scientists and help establish reusable methods, coding standards, and implementation practices.

Key Responsibilities

Advanced Analytics and Statistical Modeling

Design and implement statistical analyses, predictive models, machine-learning solutions, and analytical frameworks.
Translate workforce and organizational questions into measurable hypotheses, appropriate methodologies, and actionable insights.
Apply techniques such as regression, classification, clustering, survival analysis, forecasting, experimentation, and causal inference.
Perform feature engineering, variable selection, model tuning, validation, sensitivity testing, and performance evaluation.
Apply explainability methods such as SHAP, feature attribution, and scenario analysis.
Clearly document and communicate analytical assumptions, limitations, findings, and business implications.

Generative AI and Agentic Solutions

Design and build Generative AI applications, Retrieval-Augmented Generation solutions, and agentic workflows.
Implement tool calling, workflow orchestration, structured outputs, multi-turn interactions, and state management.
Integrate foundation models through approved enterprise gateways and cloud platforms.
Develop reusable prompts, agents, tools, evaluation components, and analytical services.
Build evaluation frameworks to measure accuracy, groundedness, retrieval quality, task completion, consistency, and hallucination risk.
Test and optimize solutions for reliability, performance, latency, cost, and user experience.

Data Engineering and Solution Implementation

Partner with data engineers and architects to design data pipelines, analytical datasets, feature-generation processes, APIs, and production integrations.
Develop clean, reusable, and well-documented Python and SQL code for analytical and AI solutions.
Work with structured and unstructured data from multiple enterprise sources.
Implement data-quality checks, logging, monitoring, error handling, and traceability within analytical workflows.
Support the development of feature libraries, embedding pipelines, vector-search capabilities, and model services.
Move prototypes into scalable production solutions using established MLOps and LLMOps practices.

Governance and Responsible AI

Ensure solutions comply with applicable Model Risk Management, privacy, cybersecurity, data-governance, and responsible AI requirements.
Implement appropriate access controls, data entitlements, PII protections, cohort-suppression rules, and analytical safeguards.
Conduct model-performance, explainability, bias, fairness, stability, and outcome testing.
Support controls for prompt-injection detection, approved tool use, source grounding, and model-output validation.
Prepare documentation covering methodologies, data dependencies, testing, limitations, controls, and implementation decisions.
Partner with risk and control functions to address findings and support required reviews.

Technical Leadership and Collaboration

Serve as a technical lead for complex data-science and AI initiatives while remaining a hands-on individual contributor.
Provide technical guidance and peer review to data scientists working on related solutions.
Help establish standards for coding, analytical design, model validation, testing, documentation, and deployment.
Partner with product managers, data engineers, architects, technology teams, and business stakeholders throughout implementation.
Present complex technical concepts and analytical results in clear language for business and senior stakeholders.
Contribute to delivery planning, solution design, technical decision-making, and resolution of implementation issues.

Experience

Qualifications and Required Skills

Typically, six or more years of relevant experience in data science, machine learning, statistical modeling, advanced analytics, AI implementation, or a related field.
Demonstrated experience implementing analytical, machine-learning, or AI solutions in an enterprise environment.
Experience moving solutions from research and prototyping through validation, production deployment, and monitoring.
Ability to lead complex technical work independently and collaborate effectively across multidisciplinary teams.
Experience operating within a regulated environment is beneficial.

Technical Expertise

Strong knowledge of statistical modeling, probability, regression, classification, clustering, forecasting, experimentation, and model validation.
Advanced proficiency in Python and libraries such as Pandas, NumPy, SciPy, Scikit-learn, Statsmodels, PyTorch, or TensorFlow.
Strong SQL skills and experience with data extraction, transformation, analytical cohort development, and data-quality testing.
Experience designing or implementing Generative AI, Retrieval-Augmented Generation, tool-calling, or agentic applications.
Familiarity with frameworks such as Google Agent Development Kit, LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, or comparable technologies.
Experience integrating foundation models through enterprise AI platforms such as Google Cloud and Vertex AI, Microsoft Azure, or AWS.
Understanding of APIs, data pipelines, vector embeddings, semantic search, and production integration patterns.
Familiarity with MLOps or LLMOps practices, including versioning, testing, deployment, observability, monitoring, and change management.
Knowledge of responsible AI, model explainability, bias and fairness testing, data privacy, and role-based access controls.

Beneficial Experience

Experience in People Analytics, Workforce Planning, Human Capital Management, organizational effectiveness, or financial-services analytics.
Experience working with sensitive workforce data and governed analytical environments.
Familiarity with enterprise software-development practices, source control, automated testing, and CI/CD.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical methods to non-technical audiences.

Education

Master’s degree or Ph.D. in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering, Economics, Operations Research, or another quantitative discipline.
A bachelor’s degree with substantial relevant technical and implementation experience may also be considered.

jobs.description:
At FSRA, our vision is to ensure financial safety, fairness, and choice for Ontarians. As a financial services regulator, we’re passionate about protecting consumers. Our principles-based approach means we can quickly and effectively respond to the changing needs of consumers and the industry.

Our team combines industry expertise with commitment to public service. We attract individuals who are interested in meaningful work and who measure success through outcomes, not inputs.

At FSRA, we invest in the personal and professional growth of our team. We offer a competitive compensation package that includes an employer-matched defined benefit pension plan, and a comprehensive and competitive benefits plan. We prioritize learning and development, wellbeing, diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging, and community giving.

Join FSRA and help us shape the future of regulation for generations to come!

Job Description:

Hiring Range:
$149,00-$199,00 (hiring range and will be determined based on the successful candidate's qualifications, skills, and relevant experience)

PURPOSE OF POSITION

To provide strategic leadership, business ownership, and program direction for FSRA’s Property & Casualty Auto Transformation Program, a multi-year initiative to modernize auto insurance regulation through the implementation of a new supervisory technology platform and future-state operating model.

The position leads the design, implementation, change management, benefits realization, and operational transition required to enable FSRA’s future Auto Insurance Supervisory Model, including insurer accreditation, risk-based supervision, advanced analytics, streamlined regulatory processes, and enhanced market oversight. Working collaboratively with internal business areas, technology partners, system integrators, insurers, and other stakeholders, the position supports FSRA’s broader modernization agenda by advancing innovative, data-driven, automated, and sustainable supervisory approaches that strengthen regulatory effectiveness and improve consumer outcomes in Ontario.

Key Responsibilities

Auto Transformation Program Leadership

Lead the delivery of FSRA's Auto Transformation Program, ensuring successful implementation of the new supervisory technology platform, associated business processes, and future-state operating model.
Establish and maintain program governance, executive reporting, performance measures, and oversight mechanisms to support successful delivery.
Manage program scope, budget, timelines, risks, dependencies, and resource requirements while ensuring alignment with strategic objectives and approved business outcomes.
Lead implementation planning, readiness assessments, operational transition activities, and post-implementation stabilization.
Provide strategic advice and recommendations to senior leadership on program direction, delivery risks, and transformation opportunities.

Supervisory Modernization and Business Transformation

Lead the design of the future-state supervisory operating model supporting risk-based regulation and insurer accreditation.
Work across supervision, actuarial, policy, legal, operations, and technology teams to redesign business processes and improve regulatory effectiveness.
Ensure the transformation supports enhanced supervisory capabilities, proactive oversight, market intelligence, and consumer outcome monitoring.
Drive process simplification, automation, standardization, and continuous improvement across regulatory operations.

Technology Enablement and Innovation

Partner with Information Technology, vendors, and system integrators to ensure business requirements are effectively translated into technology solutions.
Champion the use of automation, artificial intelligence, workflow technologies, and advanced analytics to improve supervisory effectiveness and efficiency.
Guide development of capabilities including risk-based filing triage and decisioning, regulatory workflow and case management, supervisory analytics and market intelligence, AI-assisted supervision, digital insurer experience and self-service functionality and enterprise reporting and regulatory intelligence capabilities.

Stakeholder Engagement and Change Leadership

Serve as the primary business lead for stakeholder engagement related to the transformation program.
Build and maintain strong relationships with insurers, industry associations, technology partners, and other stakeholders.
Lead organizational change management, communications, training, and adoption activities required to support successful implementation.
Represent FSRA at industry forums, conferences, working groups, and stakeholder engagements related to regulatory modernization and supervisory transformation.

Benefits Realization And Business Performance

Monitor achievement of expected outcomes, including reduced filing review cycle times, increased supervisory capacity, improved stakeholder experience, enhanced regulatory intelligence, greater operational efficiency and improved market oversight capabilities.
Establish and maintain a comprehensive governance and performance management framework, including KPI tracking, outcome measurement, benefits realization, and executive reporting, to ensure delivery of strategic objectives and sustainable transformation outcomes

Leadership and People Management

Lead and develop a team responsible for transformation delivery, business modernization, and strategic initiatives.
Foster collaboration across supervision, actuarial, policy, legal, operations, data, and technology teams.
Contribute to the ongoing evolution of FSRA's Auto Insurance Supervisory Model and broader regulatory modernization efforts.
Champion innovation, accountability, continuous improvement, and evidence-based decision-making.

Qualifications

Education

University degree in business, public administration, technology, finance, insurance, economics, engineering, or a related field or an equivalent combination or education and experience
Master's degree, project management designation, or relevant professional designation considered an asset.

Experience

10+ years of progressive leadership experience within the property and casualty insurance sector, financial services, regulatory environment, or a similarly complex operating environment.
Demonstrated experience leading major business and technology transformation initiatives
Experience leading complex organizational change and business transformation initiatives impacting both internal and external stakeholders.
Experience leveraging technology, analytics, automation, and artificial intelligence to improve business outcomes.

Knowledge And Skills

Executive-level experience serving as a senior business lead, program owner, or transformation sponsor for complex, enterprise-scale technology implementations.
Proven ability to engage effectively with executive leadership, external vendors, industry stakeholders, and governance bodies to advance strategic priorities and delivery outcomes.
Advanced understanding of the property and casualty insurance sector, including regulatory environments, market dynamics, emerging risks, and industry trends.
Deep knowledge of digital transformation, operating model design, business process modernization, technology-enabled service delivery, and implementation best practices.
Strong understanding of supervisory frameworks, risk-based regulation, governance models, accountability structures, and performance measurement disciplines.
Exceptional strategic judgement, enterprise program leadership, decision-making, and stakeholder relationship management capabilities.
Highly effective communication, executive briefing, negotiation, and influencing skills, with the ability to build alignment across diverse audiences.
Ability to synthesize complex business, regulatory, operational, and technology issues into clear recommendations, practical implementation strategies, and measurable outcomes.
Demonstrated record of successfully leading large-scale transformation and change initiatives, while building engaged, accountable, and high-performing teams.

jobs.title: Director, FP&A (Revenue)
jobs.description:
Meet Benevity

Benevity is the way the world does good, providing companies (and their employees) with technology to take social action on the issues they care about. Through giving, volunteering, grantmaking, employee resource groups and micro-actions, we help most of the Fortune 100 brands build better cultures and use their power for good. We’re also one of the first B Corporations in Canada, meaning we’re as committed to purpose as we are to profits. We have people working all over the world, including Canada, Spain, Switzerland, the United Kingdom, the United States and more!

Benevity is looking for a Director, Financial Planning & Analysis to lead revenue planning, reporting and operations in one connected team. Reporting to our SVP, Finance, you will own how we set revenue targets, track commits and actuals, forecast, and pay for performance, and you will lead the Revenue Operations team that powers our go-to-market engine.

This is a new, expanded role that brings FP&A and RevOps together. You will turn revenue data into decisions: building commission plans that motivate the right behaviour, forecasting with Sales, Client Success and Finance, and giving executives a single, trusted view of the revenue business. You will lead a team that includes a Revenue Operations group and an FP&A analyst who owns accounting and reporting for revenue.

If you love the intersection of finance and go-to-market, want to move a team from reporting to planning, and are motivated by a mission-driven company, this role is for you.

What You’ll Do

Revenue planning and forecasting

Own the revenue plan: set bookings, ARR and revenue targets and translate them into quotas and territory or segment capacity in partnership with Sales, Client Success and Marketing
Lead company-wide revenue forecast cycle in partnership with GTM Operations.
Prepare scenario analysis and sensitivity modeling to support GTM planning and Sales leadership conversations.
Partner with Finance and GTM leadership during the annual planning cycle, aligning revenue targets, headcount assumptions and GTM investment with financial models and board-level plans.
Build and maintain financial models that link GTM drivers (pipeline, conversion, retention, expansion) to financial outcomes.

Revenue reporting and insight

Develop executive-level dashboards and deliver trusted weekly, monthly and quarterly reporting on top line performance
Translate complex data into clear, actionable insights that shape GTM strategy and drive performance improvements.
Standardize KPIs and definitions across Sales, Marketing and Customer Success, creating a single source of truth for the organization.
Oversee revenue reporting and reconciliation work with Accounting to keep reported revenue accurate, timely and auditable

Sales Compensation

Design, model and refresh sales commission and incentive plans aligned to company strategy and budget
Oversee commission calculation, administration, auditing and dispute resolution, including tooling and controls
Forecast commission expense and report on plan effectiveness, attainment and payout trends

Leadership

Lead, coach and develop a team that includes Revenue Operations and an FP&A analyst, building planning capability alongside strong reporting
Act as a trusted advisor to the executive team, translating financial and operational data into recommendations
Drive continuous improvement in processes, systems and controls as we scale and implement new financial planning tools

What You’ll Bring

8+ years of progressive experience in FP&A, revenue operations, sales finance or a related field, including 3+ years leading people; SaaS or fintech experience strongly preferred
Hands-on experience designing sales commission and incentive plans, and administering them in a tool such as CaptivateIQ or Xactly
Deep experience with revenue reporting and forecasting: targets, pipeline and commit management, actuals, and variance analysis
Advanced financial modeling skills, plus experience with planning software (e.g., Pigment, Adaptive Insights, Anaplan) and an ERP such as NetSuite
Strong command of Salesforce and BI tools (e.g., Tableau), and an understanding of SaaS and fintech metrics
Proven ability to build and scale processes, systems and controls across a go-to-market organization
Curiosity about AI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT) and a track record of using them to improve analysis and automate reporting
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to present to executives and influence Sales, Client Success and Finance leaders
A coaching mindset: you build teams, develop talent and bring people together across functions
Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business or a related field; MBA, CPA or CFA is an asset

Discover your purpose at work

We’re not employees, we’re Benevity-ites. From all locations, backgrounds and walks of life, who deserve more …

Innovative work. Growth opportunities. Caring co-workers. And a chance to do work that fills us with a sense of purpose.

If the idea of working on tech that helps people do good in the world lights you up ... If you want a career where you’re valued for who you are and challenged to see who you can become …

It’s time to join Benevity. We’re so excited to meet you.

Where We Work

At Benevity, we embrace a flexible hybrid approach to where we work that empowers our people in a way that supports great work, strong relationships, and personal well-being. For those located near one of our offices, while there’s no set requirement for in-office time, we do value the moments when coming together in person helps us build connection and collaboration. Whether it’s for onboarding, project work, or a chance to align and bond as a team, we trust our people to make thoughtful decisions about when showing up in person matters most.

Join a Company Where DEIB Isn’t a Buzzword

Diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging are part of Benevity’s DNA. You’ll see the impact of our massive investment in DEIB daily — from our well-supported employee resources groups to the exceptional diversity on our leadership and tech teams.

We know that diverse backgrounds, experiences, skills and passions are what move our business and our people forward, so we're committed to creating a culture of belonging with equal opportunities for everyone to shine.

That starts with a fair and accessible hiring process. If you want to feel seen, heard and celebrated, you belong at Benevity.

Benevity is the way the world does good, providing companies (and their employees) with technology to take social action on the issues they care about. Through giving, volunteering, grantmaking, employee resource groups and micro-actions, we help most of the Fortune 100 brands build better cultures and use their power for good. We’re also one of the first B Corporations in Canada, meaning we’re as committed to purpose as we are to profits. We have people working all over the world, including Canada, Spain, Switzerland, the United Kingdom, the United States and more!

Benevity is looking for a Director, Financial Planning & Analysis to lead revenue planning, reporting and operations in one connected team. Reporting to our SVP, Finance, you will own how we set revenue targets, track commits and actuals, forecast, and pay for performance, and you will lead the Revenue Operations team that powers our go-to-market engine.

This is a new, expanded role that brings FP&A and RevOps together. You will turn revenue data into decisions: building commission plans that motivate the right behaviour, forecasting with Sales, Client Success and Finance, and giving executives a single, trusted view of the revenue business. You will lead a team that includes a Revenue Operations group and an FP&A analyst who owns accounting and reporting for revenue.

If you love the intersection of finance and go-to-market, want to move a team from reporting to planning, and are motivated by a mission-driven company, this role is for you.

What You’ll Do

Revenue planning and forecasting

Own the revenue plan: set bookings, ARR and revenue targets and translate them into quotas and territory or segment capacity in partnership with Sales, Client Success and Marketing
Lead company-wide revenue forecast cycle in partnership with GTM Operations.
Prepare scenario analysis and sensitivity modeling to support GTM planning and Sales leadership conversations.
Partner with Finance and GTM leadership during the annual planning cycle, aligning revenue targets, headcount assumptions and GTM investment with financial models and board-level plans.
Build and maintain financial models that link GTM drivers (pipeline, conversion, retention, expansion) to financial outcomes.

Translate complex data into clear, actionable insights that shape GTM strategy and drive performance improvements.

Oversee revenue reporting and reconciliation work with Accounting to keep reported revenue accurate, timely and auditable

Sales Compensation

Design, model and refresh sales commission and incentive plans aligned to company strategy and budget
Oversee commission calculation, administration, auditing and dispute resolution, including tooling and controls
Forecast commission expense and report on plan effectiveness, attainment and payout trends

Leadership

Lead, coach and develop a team that includes Revenue Operations and an FP&A analyst, building planning capability alongside strong reporting
Act as a trusted advisor to the executive team, translating financial and operational data into recommendations
Drive continuous improvement in processes, systems and controls as we scale and implement new financial planning tools

What You’ll Bring

8+ years of progressive experience in FP&A, revenue operations, sales finance or a related field, including 3+ years leading people; SaaS or fintech experience strongly preferred
Hands-on experience designing sales commission and incentive plans, and administering them in a tool such as CaptivateIQ or Xactly
Deep experience with revenue reporting and forecasting: targets, pipeline and commit management, actuals, and variance analysis
Advanced financial modeling skills, plus experience with planning software (e.g., Pigment, Adaptive Insights, Anaplan) and an ERP such as NetSuite
Strong command of Salesforce and BI tools (e.g., Tableau), and an understanding of SaaS and fintech metrics
Proven ability to build and scale processes, systems and controls across a go-to-market organization
Curiosity about AI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT) and a track record of using them to improve analysis and automate reporting
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to present to executives and influence Sales, Client Success and Finance leaders
A coaching mindset: you build teams, develop talent and bring people together across functions
Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business or a related field; MBA, CPA or CFA is an asset

Discover your purpose at work

We’re not employees, we’re Benevity-ites. From all locations, backgrounds and walks of life, who deserve more …

Innovative work. Growth opportunities. Caring co-workers. And a chance to do work that fills us with a sense of purpose.

If the idea of working on tech that helps people do good in the world lights you up ... If you want a career where you’re valued for who you are and challenged to see who you can become …

It’s time to join Benevity. We’re so excited to meet you.

At Benevity, we embrace a flexible hybrid approach to where we work that empowers our people in a way that supports great work, strong relationships, and personal well-being. For those located near one of our offices, while there’s no set requirement for in-office time, we do value the moments when coming together in person helps us build connection and collaboration. Whether it’s for onboarding, project work, or a chance to align and bond as a team, we trust our people to make thoughtful decisions about when showing up in person matters most.

Join a Company Where DEIB Isn’t a Buzzword

Diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging are part of Benevity’s DNA. You’ll see the impact of our massive investment in DEIB daily — from our well-supported employee resources groups to the exceptional diversity on our leadership and tech teams.

We know that diverse backgrounds, experiences, skills and passions are what move our business and our people forward, so we're committed to creating a culture of belonging with equal opportunities for everyone to shine.

jobs.description:
Meet Benevity

Benevity is the way the world does good, providing companies (and their employees) with technology to take social action on the issues they care about. Through giving, volunteering, grantmaking, employee resource groups and micro-actions, we help most of the Fortune 100 brands build better cultures and use their power for good. We’re also one of the first B Corporations in Canada, meaning we’re as committed to purpose as we are to profits. We have people working all over the world, including Canada, Spain, Switzerland, the United Kingdom, the United States and more!

Benevity is looking for a Director, Financial Planning & Analysis to lead revenue planning, reporting and operations in one connected team. Reporting to our SVP, Finance, you will own how we set revenue targets, track commits and actuals, forecast, and pay for performance, and you will lead the Revenue Operations team that powers our go-to-market engine.

This is a new, expanded role that brings FP&A and RevOps together. You will turn revenue data into decisions: building commission plans that motivate the right behaviour, forecasting with Sales, Client Success and Finance, and giving executives a single, trusted view of the revenue business. You will lead a team that includes a Revenue Operations group and an FP&A analyst who owns accounting and reporting for revenue.

If you love the intersection of finance and go-to-market, want to move a team from reporting to planning, and are motivated by a mission-driven company, this role is for you.

What You’ll Do

Revenue planning and forecasting

Own the revenue plan: set bookings, ARR and revenue targets and translate them into quotas and territory or segment capacity in partnership with Sales, Client Success and Marketing
Lead company-wide revenue forecast cycle in partnership with GTM Operations.
Prepare scenario analysis and sensitivity modeling to support GTM planning and Sales leadership conversations.
Partner with Finance and GTM leadership during the annual planning cycle, aligning revenue targets, headcount assumptions and GTM investment with financial models and board-level plans.
Build and maintain financial models that link GTM drivers (pipeline, conversion, retention, expansion) to financial outcomes.

Revenue reporting and insight

Develop executive-level dashboards and deliver trusted weekly, monthly and quarterly reporting on top line performance
Translate complex data into clear, actionable insights that shape GTM strategy and drive performance improvements.
Standardize KPIs and definitions across Sales, Marketing and Customer Success, creating a single source of truth for the organization.
Oversee revenue reporting and reconciliation work with Accounting to keep reported revenue accurate, timely and auditable

Sales Compensation

Design, model and refresh sales commission and incentive plans aligned to company strategy and budget
Oversee commission calculation, administration, auditing and dispute resolution, including tooling and controls
Forecast commission expense and report on plan effectiveness, attainment and payout trends

Leadership

Lead, coach and develop a team that includes Revenue Operations and an FP&A analyst, building planning capability alongside strong reporting
Act as a trusted advisor to the executive team, translating financial and operational data into recommendations
Drive continuous improvement in processes, systems and controls as we scale and implement new financial planning tools

What You’ll Bring

8+ years of progressive experience in FP&A, revenue operations, sales finance or a related field, including 3+ years leading people; SaaS or fintech experience strongly preferred
Hands-on experience designing sales commission and incentive plans, and administering them in a tool such as CaptivateIQ or Xactly
Deep experience with revenue reporting and forecasting: targets, pipeline and commit management, actuals, and variance analysis
Advanced financial modeling skills, plus experience with planning software (e.g., Pigment, Adaptive Insights, Anaplan) and an ERP such as NetSuite
Strong command of Salesforce and BI tools (e.g., Tableau), and an understanding of SaaS and fintech metrics
Proven ability to build and scale processes, systems and controls across a go-to-market organization
Curiosity about AI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT) and a track record of using them to improve analysis and automate reporting
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to present to executives and influence Sales, Client Success and Finance leaders
A coaching mindset: you build teams, develop talent and bring people together across functions
Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business or a related field; MBA, CPA or CFA is an asset

We’re not employees, we’re Benevity-ites. From all locations, backgrounds and walks of life, who deserve more …

Innovative work. Growth opportunities. Caring co-workers. And a chance to do work that fills us with a sense of purpose.

If the idea of working on tech that helps people do good in the world lights you up ... If you want a career where you’re valued for who you are and challenged to see who you can become …

It’s time to join Benevity. We’re so excited to meet you.

The role will design analytical approaches, develop and validate models, build Generative AI and agentic workflows, and partner with data engineers and technology teams to implement scalable production solutions.

Advanced Analytics and Statistical Modeling

Design and implement statistical analyses, predictive models, machine-learning solutions, and analytical frameworks.

Apply techniques such as regression, classification, clustering, survival analysis, forecasting, experimentation, and causal inference.
Perform feature engineering, variable selection, model tuning, validation, sensitivity testing, and performance evaluation.
Apply explainability methods such as SHAP, feature attribution, and scenario analysis.
Clearly document and communicate analytical assumptions, limitations, findings, and business implications.

Generative AI and Agentic Solutions

Develop reusable prompts, agents, tools, evaluation components, and analytical services.

Move prototypes into scalable production solutions using established MLOps and LLMOps practices.

Contribute to delivery planning, solution design, technical decision-making, and resolution of implementation issues.

Experience moving solutions from research and prototyping through validation, production deployment, and monitoring.
Ability to lead complex technical work independently and collaborate effectively across multidisciplinary teams.
Experience operating within a regulated environment is beneficial.

Strong knowledge of statistical modeling, probability, regression, classification, clustering, forecasting, experimentation, and model validation.
Advanced proficiency in Python and libraries such as Pandas, NumPy, SciPy, Scikit-learn, Statsmodels, PyTorch, or TensorFlow.
Strong SQL skills and experience with data extraction, transformation, analytical cohort development, and data-quality testing.
Experience designing or implementing Generative AI, Retrieval-Augmented Generation, tool-calling, or agentic applications.

Our team combines industry expertise with commitment to public service. We attract individuals who are interested in meaningful work and who measure success through outcomes, not inputs.

At FSRA, we invest in the personal and professional growth of our team. Join FSRA and help us shape the future of regulation for generations to come!

Auto Transformation Program Leadership

Establish and maintain program governance, executive reporting, performance measures, and oversight mechanisms to support successful delivery.
Manage program scope, budget, timelines, risks, dependencies, and resource requirements while ensuring alignment with strategic objectives and approved business outcomes.
Lead implementation planning, readiness assessments, operational transition activities, and post-implementation stabilization.
Provide strategic advice and recommendations to senior leadership on program direction, delivery risks, and transformation opportunities.

Work across supervision, actuarial, policy, legal, operations, and technology teams to redesign business processes and improve regulatory effectiveness.

Partner with Information Technology, vendors, and system integrators to ensure business requirements are effectively translated into technology solutions.
Champion the use of automation, artificial intelligence, workflow technologies, and advanced analytics to improve supervisory effectiveness and efficiency.
Guide development of capabilities including risk-based filing triage and decisioning, regulatory workflow and case management, supervisory analytics and market intelligence, AI-assisted supervision, digital insurer experience and self-service functionality and enterprise reporting and regulatory intelligence capabilities.

Stakeholder Engagement and Change Leadership

Serve as the primary business lead for stakeholder engagement related to the transformation program.
Build and maintain strong relationships with insurers, industry associations, technology partners, and other stakeholders.
Lead organizational change management, communications, training, and adoption activities required to support successful implementation.
Represent FSRA at industry forums, conferences, working groups, and stakeholder engagements related to regulatory modernization and supervisory transformation.

Benefits Realization And Business Performance

Monitor achievement of expected outcomes, including reduced filing review cycle times, increased supervisory capacity, improved stakeholder experience, enhanced regulatory intelligence, greater operational efficiency and improved market oversight capabilities.
Establish and maintain a comprehensive governance and performance management framework, including KPI tracking, outcome measurement, benefits realization, and executive reporting, to ensure delivery of strategic objectives and sustainable transformation outcomes

Leadership and People Management

Lead and develop a team responsible for transformation delivery, business modernization, and strategic initiatives.
Foster collaboration across supervision, actuarial, policy, legal, operations, data, and technology teams.
Contribute to the ongoing evolution of FSRA's Auto Insurance Supervisory Model and broader regulatory modernization efforts.
Champion innovation, accountability, continuous improvement, and evidence-based decision-making.

Education

University degree in business, public administration, technology, finance, insurance, economics, engineering, or a related field or an equivalent combination or education and experience
Master's degree, project management designation, or relevant professional designation considered an asset.

Experience

10+ years of progressive leadership experience within the property and casualty insurance sector, financial services, regulatory environment, or a similarly complex operating environment.
Demonstrated experience leading major business and technology transformation initiatives
Experience leading complex organizational change and business transformation initiatives impacting both internal and external stakeholders.
Experience leveraging technology, analytics, automation, and artificial intelligence to improve business outcomes.

Knowledge And Skills

Executive-level experience serving as a senior business lead, program owner, or transformation sponsor for complex, enterprise-scale technology implementations.
Proven ability to engage effectively with executive leadership, external vendors, industry stakeholders, and governance bodies to advance strategic priorities and delivery outcomes.
Advanced understanding of the property and casualty insurance sector, including regulatory environments, market dynamics, emerging risks, and industry trends.
Deep knowledge of digital transformation, operating model design, business process modernization, technology-enabled service delivery, and implementation best practices.
Strong understanding of supervisory frameworks, risk-based regulation, governance models, accountability structures, and performance measurement disciplines.
